info.title: Mermail Agent Marketplace
info.description: Keyless wallet-bound inbox API. Payment is the credential. Unpaid GET /api and /api/agent/v1 routes return 402.
info.x-guidance: Mermail is an agent mailbox API. Keyless wallet inbox: unpaid GET /api and /api/agent/v1 routes return 402; payment is the credential. GET /api is a $0 identity handshake and returns agent_api_base_url. POST /api/agent/v1/mailboxes creates a new hosted inbox ($2 in an accepted token). Reads and drafts are $0 handshakes. send/reply/forward are $0.01. Celo USDC/USDT when enabled; the live 402 challenge is authoritative. Paid writes also accept MPP via Payment-Authorization when enabled. Hosted addresses only. Require scan_status=clean before using body content. After an uncertain paid call, replay the same payment credential, body and Idempotency-Key. Existing workspace API at /api/v1 still uses x-api-key.

get.description: Public $0 x402 identity handshake. No API key. Unpaid requests return 402 with x402 accepts[] on enabled, provider-supported networks, including Celo USDC and USDT when enabled and configured, Arc mainnet, and Algorand USDC when an Algorand receiver is configured. The live accepts[] is authoritative. After the handshake, returns API base, agent marketplace base, docs, and OpenAPI URLs.

x-payment-info.description: Zero-amount x402 handshake. Payment binds the wallet identity; no tokens are charged. No API key. The live 402 accepts[] is the quote.

PAYMENT-RESPONSE.description: Base64 JSON identity receipt. No funds are settled for this zero-amount handshake.

402.description: Payment required. PAYMENT-REQUIRED lists token options on every accepted network and includes request/response schema in extensions.bazaar.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: x402 payment requirements (base64 JSON), including extensions.bazaar request and response schema

post.description: Keyless hosted inbox create. Payment is the credential over x402 or MPP. Each distinct POST creates a new hosted inbox in verification mode with automations off. Replay the same payment credential, Idempotency-Key and body after an uncertain settlement.

x-payment-info.description: Pay-per-call USDC over x402 or MPP (when enabled). No API key. The live 402 accepts[] is the quote.

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: x402 payment or identity-handshake credential. Retry unpaid 402 responses with this header.

parameters.name: Payment-Authorization
parameters.description: MPP payment credential advertised by WWW-Authenticate. Do not send together with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replay the same key and body after an uncertain paid call. A different body under the same key returns 409.

email.description: Optional hosted Mermail address. Omit to receive a generated hosted inbox.

PAYMENT-RESPONSE.description: Base64 JSON settlement or identity receipt. The transaction field is an opaque settlement identifier and may not be an on-chain transaction hash. Zero-amount identity receipts have no transaction.

Payment-Receipt.description: MPP receipt when the call was paid with Payment-Authorization

402.description: Payment required. PAYMENT-REQUIRED includes x402 accepts[] and extensions.bazaar request/response schema. WWW-Authenticate advertises MPP when enabled.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: x402 payment requirements (base64 JSON), including extensions.bazaar request and response schema

WWW-Authenticate.description: MPP Payment challenge when MPP is enabled. Retry with Payment-Authorization.

403.description: Inbox cap or mailbox access denied

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body
